notes.title: Grand update of the game page
notes.content:
Welcome tower defenders!

We worked hard and created almost all of the starter content:
- 4 biomes
- 18 missions
- tons of fun emotions and achievements
- 10 extravagant towers
- many creatures and buildings

In this regard, we have updated the look of the game page.

We're polishing and balancing the gameplay while you enjoy the new look for the game page.

One month left before the release!

[previewyoutube=pHDYlcY8lQk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: All missions are ready!
notes.content:
Our dear masters!
We are glad to inform you that the preparation of the starter set of missions is over!
You can try yourself both as a well-wisher and as a villain;)
There is little to wait, please be patient!

[previewyoutube=fBJm2jW1mIk;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=2ko2yqivotc;full][/previewyoutube]

We keep improving the environment and balancing the game.

notes.title: Oh yeah! The last tower is ready!
notes.content:
We finished work on ten towers of hormones. Their combinations will create about fifty emotions. 
You can find the rest of the emotions in the districts or in the buildings of the villages.

We are currently focusing on setting up environments, balance and missions.
